Best practices

When developing core Deploy App, as well as if you want your product integration to ship into our official delivery, you must follow our best practices.

CI templates

We recommend and with our core components & official product integrations, require you to follow our CI standards. The CI standards are written as a reusable library so you can instantly start utilizing them. It makes it easy to start using tools like proper pre-commit, versioning, and github actions-based runs, in order to deliver your code quality to the standards.
